how:
Does the third reading notice a wrong value? Twenty-one wrong values are planted in a copy of the dataset (never in the
real file) and the third reading is run on the copy. Every planted error must be reported, and nothing else.
usage: python3 mutation_test.py <verify_plumber.py> <plumber-words.json> <business-cases.json> <work-dir> <out.json>

results.as: purpose split (%): third reading [100, 0, 0, 0] | dataset [0, 100, 0, 0]
wards: third reading [7] | dataset [8]
ftes: third reading [17, 15, 13, 13] | dataset [18, 15, 13, 13]

results.planted_error: an ongoing amount moved from 2028 to 2029
results.as: ongoing_m: third reading [2.1, 0.7, None, None] | dataset [2.1, None, 0.7, None]
one_time_m: third reading [20.4, 92.9, None, None] | dataset [2.04, 92.9, None, None]

results.planted_error: a word dropped from a title
results.as: title: third reading 'accelerating housing development bill 20 and residential sub-classes' | dataset 'accelerating housing development bill
risk rating: third reading 'Extensive' | dataset 'Low'
department: third reading 'planning & development services' | dataset 'community services'
funding source: third reading 'reserves self-supported debt' | dataset 'reserves'

results.planted_error: Budget ID changed by one character
results.as: budget id: third reading 'p616 000' | dataset 'p616 001'
stage: third reading 'stage 3 plan & design' | dataset 'stage 3 define'
rationale: third reading 'risk-based considerations' | dataset 'explicit'
"Required" statement: third reading True | dataset False
one_time_m: third reading [None, None, None, None] | dataset [0.0, None, None, None]

results.planted_error: the full one-time amount in the City note removed
results.as: full one-time request stated in the note: third reading 23.9 | dataset None

results.planted_error: the "City note under the table" mark removed
results.as: City note under the table (a starred amount row, or a second star on the FTE row): third reading True | dataset False
long-term plan: third reading 'routeahead' | dataset 'routeahead and another plan'
Council priority printed on the case = its contents section: third reading False | dataset True
